verdict.rationale: Modal documents programmatic creation of isolated sandboxes through its Python, JS and Go SDKs: you create a Sandbox with a chosen image and volume, then exec commands against the live object. Community builders report building runners on Sandboxes and controlling them over gRPC, though neither says anything about startup speed. The 'in seconds' claim comes only from vendor marketing about concurrent environments, plus a release note on a faster creation backend. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on measurement of cold-start latency, and an explicit documented single-call create snippet showing time-to-ready.
